verdict: Leads surged this week at low cost, but setup milestones need to close.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 30 leads at $6.15 cost per lead on $184.42 in spend — and the past 7 days alone drove a 228% jump in lead volume while cost per lead fell 68%, confirming the paid campaign is working efficiently. That momentum is real, but its full value is limited until the setup work planned from July onward is confirmed complete: landing pages, CRM routing, search campaigns, and nurture sequences are all unconfirmed live, which means leads arriving now may not be flowing into a fully built intake system. We're actively working to close those open milestones so the lead volume you're generating can be captured and converted end-to-end. With Phase 1 closing September 30, the priority this week is confirming each piece of the stack is live and connected.
